title: How Does Your Samsung Galaxy Watch Measure Antioxidant Levels? - BGR
summary: To use the Antioxidant Index tool on your watch, all you have to do is go to the Antioxidant Index tile from the Samsung Health app. One, the Galaxy Watch's Antioxidant Index isn't solely based on your skin carotenoid level.
